subject: PoC blocked: request for extension & sandbox credit — CloudCompass
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@cloudcompass.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@cloudcompass.io>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: PoC blocked: integration failing in staging — need extension + credits

Hi Irene,

Quick note from the CloudCompass engineering team — our connector to Redwood's hosted API started returning 500s under a realistic payload yesterday. The team traced it to an unexpected timeout when warming the session (we've attached the integration logs). This has stalled our PoC test runs and we'll miss our demo window on Monday without extra sandbox runway.

Ask: can Redwood grant a 2-week trial extension and provide additional sandbox credits (we estimate ~15k tokens) while our engineers sort the integration? We can share the logs and screenshares; we'd also accept a short troubleshooting session with an engineer if that's possible.

Attachments: CloudCompass_Integration_Log_20270110.pdf, SOW_CloudCompass_v1.docx

Thanks — appreciate any quick help.

Samir Patel
Senior Platform Engineer, CloudCompass
samir@cloudcompass.io
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloudcompass.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PoC blocked: integration failing in staging — need extension + credits

Hi Samir — thanks for the quick context and for sending the logs. I'm sorry the integration is blocking your demo.

A few quick clarifying questions so we can move fast:
- Are the 500s reproducible on a new session warmup or only under long histories?
- Which model/endpoint are you calling and what's your typical sequence length for the failing requests?
- Have you tried using our lightweight adapter (v1.2) included in the SOW?

Operationally, I can provision a provisional sandbox credit and extend the PoC window while our support engineer works with your team. I'm looping in Ben from Sales to align on the credit amount and formal signoff.

If you can share a short snippet (redacted) of the failing request and confirm a time for a 30-minute troubleshooting call, we'll schedule an engineer.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

On Fri, Jan 15, 2027 at 08:12 AM Samir Patel <samir@cloudcompass.io> wrote:
> Hi Irene,
> 
> Quick note from the CloudCompass engineering team — our connector to Redwood's hosted API started returning 500s under a realistic payload yesterday...

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@cloudcompass.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 10:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PoC blocked: integration failing in staging — need extension + credits

Thanks for the details — looping in Neha to expedite approval. Short answer: we can cover an initial sandbox credit here while we triage. Proposed interim offer: 10,000 tokens of sandbox credit + a 2-week trial extension, conditional on closing the PoC with an agreed remediation plan. If engineering diagnostics show this is due to an SDK mismatch we can provide an engineer session to help isolate.

Samir — if that sounds reasonable we'll mark the credit in HubSpot and get a signed amendment if needed. Neha — do you have capacity to approve the credit today or should we escalate to finance?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@cloudcompass.io>
Date: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PoC blocked: integration failing in staging — need extension + credits

Approved.

Authorization: Redwood will provide a two-week extension to CloudCompass's PoC and issue a one-time 15,000-token sandbox credit to be applied to the CloudCompass account (deal CCP-2027-0012). Additionally, we'll schedule a 60-minute engineering troubleshooting session (no charge) with our integrations team within the next three business days.

I'll attach the internal approval memo for records. Ben, please update the HubSpot deal and make sure Procurement receives the amendment for signature. Samir — we'll coordinate the scheduling email separately.

Attachment: redwood-approval-CCP-0012.pdf

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@cloudcompass.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PoC blocked: integration failing in staging — need extension + credits

Team — this is great, thank you. We accept the 15k token credit and the two-week extension. I can do a troubleshooting session on Wed 1/20 at 10:00 PT (our engineers are free then) — that should be enough to get past the warmup issue.

Next steps for us:
- I will send a short replay of the failing request ahead of the call (redacted).
- Procurement will look out for the amendment and sign it.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this keeps our Monday demo window salvageable.

Best,
Samir
Senior Platform Engineer, CloudCompass
